about: The one product file allowed over 800 lines: desktop/src/main/main.ts (1169 lines), frozen on purpose (Botling 2 only, not split, user 2026-11-16). Its number stays; no card lowers or removes the entry, and the check fails if the file grows. Every other product file may have at most 800 lines, and a file not listed here that passes 800 fails the check. Checked by desktop/scripts/check-lines.mjs, which CI runs in the desktop job (npm run check:lines).
